confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from five web searches. They returned mostly secondary aggregator and travel-guide figures for Ocho Rios, some dated 2023, and none was a verified current menu. I nudged them up modestly for the tourist-corridor setting and 2026 prices. Cocktail and wine are the weakest of these: I found one budget-guide cocktail figure of about 8 USD and only retail wine prices. I set them mainly from the beer relationship (cocktail about 2.7x beer, wine glass about 2.5x beer). Menu snippets of unconfirmed location were not used. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not based on live listings or booking pages. Hostel prices are especially uncertain because the north-coast market is mostly all-inclusive resorts with few registered hostels.
comparable_city_reasoning: Jamaican tourist-corridor towns such as Montego Bay and Negril, with Kingston as a lower-cost local reference. This is Caribbean resort-town pricing, with Jamaica grouped under Latin America and the Caribbean.
